title: Floral blue fashion poster
reference_style: Oversized pale-blue title, formal black tailoring, pink blossom frame and studio-blue atmosphere.

reverse_engineered_prompt.concept: Luxury pop-culture fashion poster combining a formal portrait, oversized typography and romantic floral cut-outs.

subject.type: Young adult male celebrity-inspired editorial subject
subject.pose: Three-quarter standing portrait, shoulders angled slightly, head turned toward camera
subject.expression: Playful candid expression with a small flower placed over one eye
subject.wardrobe: Black velvet tuxedo jacket, crisp white shirt and black bow tie

composition.layout: Subject centered in front of giant title letters; flowers overlap the shoulders and lower foreground
composition.background: Deep-to-bright cobalt and powder-blue gradient with soft luminous center
composition.florals: Dense pale-pink blossoms and delicate branches arranged as a halo behind the subject, with a large foreground bouquet

typography.headline: MUSIC
typography.style: Extra-large condensed uppercase sans serif in pale icy blue, spanning almost the full width
typography.subtitle: THE BEST IN THE WORLD
typography.placement: Small centered white uppercase line above headline
typography.layering: Typography behind subject and partially hidden by floral elements

lighting.palette: Cobalt, ice blue, blush pink, black and white

camera.depth_of_field: Subject crisp, floral layers slightly varied in focus

post_processing.composite: Precise subject masking, flower cut-outs, oversized type layers and atmospheric blue glow
post_processing.finish: Glossy music-magazine cover with tactile botanical detail

reverse_engineered_prompt.negative_prompt: No malformed hands, duplicate flowers fused to face, unreadable title, excessive bloom, logos, watermark, plastic skin.
